limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Fixed-base Schatten graph-chart results and the classical qualitative finite-rank/compact perturbation equivalences are excluded from the novelty claim. Chung's 1993 paper and older canonical-angle literature were not exhaustively inspected for an equivalent differently phrased singular-value identity.
provenance: Canonical graph/complement isometries block-diagonalize the square of the difference of two bounded graph projections into two normalized relative-difference squares; positive functional calculus gives the exact modulus decomposition.
record_title: Exact ideal profile for differences of bounded graph projections
